visual_action: Cardi B stands at a podium in front of a large crowd, reading a speech from her phone. She is dressed in a white jacket and speaks into several microphones.

cast.name: Cardi B
cast.evidence: The on-screen text identifies her: "Cardi B DESTROYS Trump". She is the sole speaker in the video.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads "Cardi B DESTROYS Trump" and Cardi B begins her speech by quoting him: "Trump says he's going to protect women..."

on_screen_text.text: Cardi B DESTROYS Trump and his “protector of women” comments 🔥🔥

spoken_summary: Reading from her phone, Cardi B quotes Donald Trump as saying he will "protect women whether they like it or not." She then challenges this, stating, "If his definition of protection is not the freedom of choice, if his definition of protection is making sure our daughters have fewer rights than our mothers, then I don't want it!" The crowd erupts in cheers as she repeats, "I don't want it."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Cardi B's speech, followed by loud, sustained cheering and applause from the large crowd.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot of the speaker. The editing consists of large, yellow, all-caps words appearing on screen one by one to emphasize key parts of her speech.
central_claim: Donald Trump's pledge to "protect women" is a thinly veiled threat to take away their rights, particularly their freedom of choice.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers that Donald Trump is a danger to women's rights and to rally opposition against him, leveraging the platform of a popular celebrity.
